purpose: The same latent neural ODE baseline as the intervention study's (augmented neural ODE driven by the measured inputs, with an encoder of the initial readings), on the eight glucose-insulin and alien-device cells of the Phase B nine-case comparison, with seeds 0, 1 and 2. Settings are copied unchanged from configs/latent_ode_intervention_v1.json. Public training trajectories of the staged nine-case inputs fit it; public validation trajectories stop training early and choose the latent dimension. It reads each cell in the validation context the nine-case D3 campaign used (raw_agent): legacy meal events and the supplied auxiliaries. No test or private file is opened.
